item.title: Muddy Waters-Backed Gold Project to Be Fast-Tracked by Ontario
item.description: A Canadian gold project backed by famed short seller Carson Block will be fast-tracked under a framework to cut permitting timelines in Ontario, extending the provincial government’s efforts to support the mining sector.

item.title: Saudi Business Model Built on Corporate Commuters Challenged by War
item.description: Soon after Houthi attacks forced Saudi Arabia to shutter its capital’s main airport, one consultant drove for hours to get to Riyadh from Oman. The executive left two weeks later and plans to return soon, this time via Doha, betting that showing up will offer an edge over rivals who’re staying away.

item.title: Indian Bonds Rally as Oil Falls, Higher Yields Attract Buyers
item.description: Indian bonds gained the most in six months on Monday as crude prices extended losses, easing inflation concerns for the fuel-importing nation.

item.title: India’s Sitharaman Aims to Keep Up Spending to Sustain Growth
item.description: India will keep up its spending on roads and bridges to ports to sustain economic growth while maintaining fiscal prudence, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said, as she begins preparations for the next federal budget.
